promotion_evidence: macOS arm64 / CoreText: ctest native_typography_contracts + canvas_compatibility_contracts (2/2, data-prototype) and a real PrivetDr renderer smoke reaching the main loop with 'text.ready'

wasm (Emscripten): same FreeType/HarfBuzz sources as Linux plus a seam that reads font files out of the module filesystem, because there is no fontconfig and a page cannot download a font at run time; web ctest 2/2, a text.ready session captured from the framebuffer

web text fallback: the game data supplies one face, so Liberation Sans, Liberation Mono and Noto Sans SC (all SIL OFL 1.1) are vendored under ThirdParty/fonts and staged beside it. Coverage is answered with FT_Get_Char_Index against each face in turn -- the role Fontconfig's charset match plays on Linux -- so a face is only credited with glyphs it really has, and nothing depends on fonts installed on the visitor's machine

wasm seam notes: EM_ASM cannot write C++ out-parameters (use setValue); the web preset is MEMORY64 so pointers need Number() in JS; Emscripten FS.readFile returns a Uint8Array for a raw read, and asking for encoding 'binary' silently zeroes every byte

NOT verified: the fallback branch has not been observed selecting a second face for a character the first one lacks; Linux arm64 has not been run with native text on; no data-retail run exists; the typography contracts are native-only so the wasm provider has no shaping assertions; and a human has not reviewed browser text for legibility
The bitmap compatibility path remains selectable everywhere via [Display] NativeText=False; canvas_compatibility_contracts pins it

FreeType.note: compiles with the default on; not run with it on, so not runtime-verified

FreeTypeEmscripten.note: text.ready observed; fallback chain staged (game face + Liberation Sans/Mono + Noto Sans SC, all OFL) and coverage is probed with FT_Get_Char_Index, but the fallback path itself has not been exercised on a character that needs it, and no one has reviewed the result
